definition: One equal division of the module. Every member's height and projection is stated in parts, so when the module changes the whole assembly grows or shrinks with it and its proportions hold.
more: The classical trim family divides the ceiling height into nineteen parts — four for the pedestal, twelve for the wall field and three for the entablature — so on a ceiling of nine feet six inches one part is exactly six inches.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's parts field and the classical trim family's own invariants. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, module.parts description: "Subdivisions of the module.
